game.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II
game.blurb: Military first-person shooter with a campaign and co-op missions, from Infinity Ward with other Activision studios, released 2022-10-22. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Finishing the Campaign
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign on any difficulty, and every mission on Veteran or Realism.

chapters.title: Mission Challenges
chapters.summary: Feats inside named missions: Prison Break, Wetwork, Ghost Team, Violence and Timing, Dark Water, the CCTV sequence, safes and more.

chapters.title: Stealth and No-Gun Feats
chapters.summary: Getting through El Sin Nombre, Countdown, Wetwork and Recon by Fire unseen, and Alone without firing a gun.

chapters.title: Campaign and Co-op Combat
chapters.summary: Flashbang and Riot Shield kills that count in the campaign or in co-op.

chapters.title: Co-op Missions
chapters.summary: Stars in Low Profile, Defender: Mt. Zaya and Denied Area, and intel fragments. Needs a partner and a network connection.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first search result was the 2009 "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2"; the 2022 game's entry "call-of-duty-modern-warfare-ii" (id 791636) was put in by hand. The Steam app list has "Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II" as app 3595230 and a separate "Call of Duty®" app (1938090), which was not checked; 3595230 was used. Its schema calls the app "Nina" (an internal codename) and has 24 achievements, none hidden, covering the campaign and co-op missions only, no multiplayer. The 2009 game is app 10180. No StrategyWiki page under "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II" or "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II (2022)". callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II", with 500 linked articles (the most the API returns in one call), mostly weapons, maps and operators, including mission pages such as "Alone (level)", "Countdown (Modern Warfare II)", "Dark Water", "El Sin Nombre (level)" and "Ghost Team"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The data does not give the mission order, so missions are grouped by kind of challenge, not by when you play them. Low Profile, Defender: Mt. Zaya and Denied Area are named only in co-op achievements, so they sit in the co-op chapter.
